title: 秋華賞の後に・絶えず前へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove has given it her all, giving an earnest performance that the audience will never forget.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Looking at the results, it wasn't a perfect race. I wasn't able to secure the honor of getting all three Tiaras.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But this is who I am right now. I have to accept my present condition and use it as fuel to take on new challenges tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I have no time to sit around moping.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Undaunted." That's the word that comes to mind when I look at Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She doesn't let any result break her. She keeps looking forward to continue challenging herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's what it means to be Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We return to the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Dober? Is everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sorry for barging in on you like this. I just wanted to say, you were great out there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And there's something else I just have to tell you…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Go on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I watched you as you faced every race of the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I watched you chase your ideal and continue to take on challenge after challenge.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And through all that… you taught me something. Not with words, but with the way you race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to keep pushing ever forward… just like you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I just… I needed to tell you that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You've really grown, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll continue to challenge myself so that I don't lose to you one day. Which is why you need to keep working hard too, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, I will! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm honestly very happy right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I have. It's rather a sobering experience.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I hope you continue to stick with me. Starting tomorrow, we aim for even greater heights!
